tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Live AuthiChain prices: StrainChain Passport, Farm, and EU DPP Payment Links for humans; unpaid POST /api/x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) for agents.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Paid AuthiChain verification. Unpaid tools/call returns HTTP 402 ($0.05 USDC on Base). Retry with X-PAYMENT.

tools.name: query_provenance
tools.description: Free public lookup for an assetId / seal / QR token. Never attests. Unknown IDs return status unknown. Cryptographic verify is tools/call verify ($0.05 USDC on Base).

tools.name: dpp_readiness_check
tools.description: Free EU Digital Product Passport readiness check. Returns a 0-100 score, gaps, and the dated obligation for the product category (battery passport is law from 18 Feb 2027; other categories are ESPR targets). Not legal advice.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pricing · Private data: query_provenance · Public sink: get_pricing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pricing · Private data: query_provenance · Public sink: get_pricing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
